summary: The AI sent a lone 3-model unit into a stack of enemy units to flip nml_1. It cannot flip it and will probably die. The center, worth 20 VP, was dropped as 'already taken' even though Beta is still 9 in away.
better_option: Move obj_center (moving to objective — worth ~20 VP)

summary: The AI kept the unit on its home objective in round 1 although no enemy can reach it for at least a turn. Hold is reasonable, but the AI never considers that the home objective is safe and could be held later.
better_option: Advance obj_center (advancing to arrive a turn sooner — worth ~10 VP)

summary: The AI sent Beta back to sit on HOME 1 because it was the sole holder. This ignores that no enemy can threaten home this turn and that other units could hold it. It wastes a 3 OC unit while Alpha goes alone to CENTER.
